notes.title: Holiday update 68 has landed!
notes.content:
Hi folks! I hope everyone is doing well. It's been quite a while since last update, how time flies! I like to get back into doing regular updates as before. So what's this one about? Read on...

Avalon v10368

- Added two new options for morale depletion, very slow and very fast
- Added option to use mouse for aiming ship turrets
- Added three new items to Ship Upgrades DLC...luxury rooms, luxury suites, and asteroid laser
- GUI graphic changes with buttons and icons that better explain ship controls at a glance
- Slightly better chance at finding data chips in certain areas
- Fixed bug which causes certain structures to not be built on moons
- Fixed issue which caused a few items to not be in ship inventory after finding or purchasing
- Fixed issue where landing on a planet would not allow explorers to disembark
- Some performance improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26620499/197ce4391dd71b5b625ef7ef3d073db03fe35566.png[/img]
In this screenshot, notice the updated ship controls at bottom left corner. Hopefully, this will help with better understanding of what your ship will do when you're controlling it.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26620499/f2ce701b9cf5e4d780d9fc731142d1af69d5d603.png[/img]
Seen here are the three added ship upgrades. The luxury rooms and luxury suites reduces morale depletion rate. The asteroid laser will increase the chance of finding resources in asteroids as they are shot and break apart. 

Ok this concludes this update and I do plan on doing more updates. Also, i'm working on getting the game migrated over to a new engine, IF it is feasible. Well that's all for now and I hope everyone has a safe and wonderful holiday season!

notes.title: Update 58 warps in!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! After lots of work and testing I bring you update 58. This update focuses mostly on the new save slot system which did make it's way in btw. Then also some added tutorial tips to help out with learning some of the basics of the game. In addition some other good stuff also made it's way in this update. So check it all out below...

Avalon_v1.0.3.58

- New save game slot system for saving multiple journeys
- New tutorial tips which can be turned on or off via tutorials in main menu
- New non-combat ship class, Food Transports which can provide food and are owned by Nomad, Malcos, and Necromancer
- Added two types of tankers for Necromancers faction
- New Malcos Kraken class battleship, equipped with 4x med lasers and a fighter squadron so be careful around these!
- The ship role for Agricultural class ships are no longer listed as food transport and are now as food supply
- Giving gc or requesting cease fire on ship comms now shows the proper tokens received
- Pressing P when on planet surface now pings the shuttle location
- Increased amount of white starts over colored stars for slight more realism
- Some minor graphic enhancements

So this concludes the update. Now that the new save system is in place and functioning, I can always add more save slots in future updates. Oh and take that Kraken Battleship seriously. Hint, if it's starts firing on you, unless you're well equipped it maybe a good idea to jump out of there asap! Cheers and have fun!

notes.title: Update 50, new ship class!
notes.content: Hello hello! This base game update introduces a new ship class, the Multi-Purpose Cruiser. Although mostly a non-combat vessel, don't let that fool you! These ships are well equipped for combat along with many other various duties. Packing 1 medium and 1 light laser they are the most heavily armed non-combat vessels in the game. They can provide a good variety of support as well, things such as resources, materials, luxury items and even personnel can be provided. So it will never hurt to attempt to strike up a good conversation with their captain's and possibly get some good stuff. So which factions have these ships? Currently the Lucicron, Orpheous, and Nomad although it is very possible more races may also get these vessels as well in future updates! So try them out but remember, be careful these are not your usual non-combat ships :)

notes.title: Update 42 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! So what is this update 42 about anyway? It's a rather small but welcoming update. In one of the previous updates, the launch probe button and hotkey started causing the game to crash. This update changes it, now the button shows probe inventory which is more useful. It was rarely used so it was changed to be more useful. Most notably, keyboard players should like this update because of the first couple listed just below. Details here...

Avalon v1.0.3.42

- Now the left and right arrow keys turn the turrets. This makes combat easier for players who use the keyboard to move instead of the mouse. The usual Z and C keys still work as well if one prefers those.

- Now pressing the down arrow key also fires weapons. The usual X key still works as well.

- The launch probe button no longer crashes the game. Also it no longer used to launch probes and instead shows probe inventory.

- Pressing P hotkey no longer launches probes.

- Now simply clicking on a planet or moon is the way to launch probes.

That is all for today. I want to mention the game and all it's dlc's are on the weeklong sale starting today. So if any of you have a friend or two that you think will like it, let them know. Last keep an eye out for more info on Ship Builders! Cheers and have a great day!

notes.content:

Coming back here with yet another update and sooner then I expected. I have never truely been satisfied with the scan screen in the game. It was something that has been on my list to redesign and improve for quite sometime now. Well that is now over because it has finally happened! I am happy with how it turned out and I hope you all are as well? Remember, I am not only the developer of the game, I am also a dedicated fan and player. So this is one thing that explains the numerous updates since the game has been released. So here are the details of this update and it's fairly hefty...

Avalon v10329

- Scan screen has been completely overhauled and greatly improved.

- Fixed animation flickering on some capital ships.

- Players now start with 8 leaders instead of 12.

- Resources, items and equipment found now account for cargo storage or launch bay as intended.

- Cargo bay no longer goes into the negative.

- Alien frigates and corvettes can now attack upon entry into a sector just as any other ship.

notes.title: Update 1010 has arrived!
notes.content:
Heya spacefarers! Have any of you found the end of the universe yet?
If not I think this may help out a lot! Introducing Avalon v1.0.1.0! This is one of the most significant updates to be released for the game to date. The biggest and most noticable change is an added sector navigation system. Players can now purchase electronic sector maps at kiosks in stations. This allows travel to numerous sector types. A new navigation panel at top right allows players to select the type of sector to warp to. Checkout the in game Avalonpedia for more info on navigation. Another cool addition is not only can players find fuel canisters and/or supply pods in space sectors, but also energy pods! Full details on this update is listed below...

Sector Map Kiosk

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26620499/4dec268644decbe04f5a131932f0ee2aed089774.png[/img]
Sylion Energy Carrier

Avalon v1.0.1.0

- Added sector maps and sector navigation system.

- New navigation panel added for navigation.

- All stations and outposts now have computer map kiosks.

- Sector maps can be bought or sold from map kiosks onboard stations or outposts.

- Ships can now give out sector maps when requesting support.

- Original location maps have been removed and replaced with the sector maps.

- Ship upgrade prices on items in shipyards have increased substantially.

- Fixed issue where pressing red X to exit game would stack exit game windows on top one another.

- Improved Sylion Supply Ship graphic.

- Added two new Sylion ships, a Destroyer and an Energy Carrier.

- Enhanced some Sylion ship graphics.

- Warp button graphic has changed.

- Players now start with 1 docking permit.

- Beacon flash is now shown on stations to better notice them mainly on the minimap.

- Added a new space extra, an energy pod.

- Avalonpedia has been updated with new infor on navigation.

Ok this concludes yet another update. As I normally mention, stick around here for info on even more cool things to come. I will be starting on the next update sometime next week. No ETA on that update yet but I will post an announcement when I have a better idea. Please send any comments, issues or suggestions to me here on the forums, or via email at contact@newhopegames.com Last, remember the Name A Planet Event 1 is starting on December 1st so join in!

notes.title: Build 023 has now landed!
notes.content:
New update! Still building away but after each update I feel the game gets a little closer to what I originally wanted it to be. Here are the details...

- Ship movement has greatly changed and is now more realistic. Thrust power is selected and set from 1 to 3, then applied in the direction the player selects. The more thrust power the stronger the impulse burst will be and the faster the ship will move. Each level of thrust power expends 4 fuel. So for example if player selects 3 then it will expend 12 fuel. Turning still expends only 1 fuel. Once the player ship is moving, it will continue to move until all stop is selected. This allows the player to "drift" for extended periods of time while not burning any fuel.

- Two new controls have been added to ship panel to set thrust power.

- Improved text help on some ship panel indicators.

- Removed warp and cool down texts on flashing lights.

- Fixed ability to buy building materials in a space port on a station.

- Tropical planets background is fixed and will now display correctly.

- Fixed planetary build and facilities can now be built as intended.

Work continues my friends, I have some great ideas for the next update! Until then have a great weekend. Now entering jump in 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, engaged!

notes.title: Update 786 has just warped in!
notes.content:
First I want to mention two new videos showing space combat have been added to the store page. Also a new screenshot of the gui. Now about the update, originally labeled as 784 but more changes have went in so the version has advanced to 786. Here is the fix, change, addition list...


FIXES:

-Pressing engage when in the ship com screen now engages as intended.

-Game no longer freezes when pressing back arrow from stat screen in an outpost.

-Pressing warp after warp is engaged will no longer play an additional audio clip.

-Aborting warp no longer expends 10 fuel

-Fixed issue which was causing players to find items in nearly every locker while on board a boarded ship.


CHANGES:

-Data chips are less frequently found on npc's and more frequently found elsewhere.

-At merchants, item and resource names are listed in green when price is low and white when average or higher.

-Prices have been adjusted greatly on all items and resources for better balance.

-Prisoners cause problems less often

-Security droids now have a limit to how many can spawn depending on the structure and no longer endlessly spawn. This allows the player a chance to escape a station, outpost or ship.

-Picking up canisters or supply pods now show a star flash to better confirm pickup of item


ADDITIONS:

-A panel has been added behind the ship controls to better define the area and give more of an on the bridge sci-fi feeling.

-Two new items have been added. Docking passes that allow free docking at stations or outposts. Location maps which provide warp to coordinates of more valuable sectors.

-Three new resource items have been added, rubber, silver and diamonds.

-A warp to button has been added. Pressing this button during countdown expends a location map and warps to a more valuable sector.

-Warships can now provide support too! When captain relations are 80 or higher you can request support. As of now warships can provide GC, Docking Passes or Location Maps.

Ok this concludes this update. I will be working on my list for next update which I am once again aiming for by end of next weekend. As always, report bugs and mention suggestions in forum. Last, if you like the game and want to help support it, please tell a friend :)
